name: Fields of Arle

rounds.endCondition: After the November Inventorying of the 9th Half Year

categories.label: Clothing tiles and building materials
categories.hint: Bricks, Linen, Woolen, Leather 1 VP each; Summer, Winter, Leather Wear 2 VP each; Timber 1/2 VP each (do not round).

categories.label: Equipment in the Barn
categories.hint: VP of Plows, Peat Boats and Vehicles (enter after applying -3 if you have no Large Vehicle).

categories.label: Travel Experience Track
categories.hint: VP at first empty space from the bottom, max 10.

categories.label: Tools
categories.hint: Sum of VP of your Tools on the 10 Tool Tracks.

categories.label: Goods Track
categories.hint: Indicator on 15 = 3 VP; 11-14 = 2 VP; 7-10 = 1 VP; double the total if you have a Depot (once only).

categories.label: Home Board
categories.hint: VP of Buildings, Stalls, Stables, Forests, Parks minus 4 per hydrated Moor, 1 per dehydrated Moor, 1 per remaining top-row Tidal Flat space.

categories.label: Animals on Home Board
categories.hint: Least-held animal type 2 VP each, second least 1 VP each, most-held type 0.

categories.label: Supply Bottlenecks
categories.hint: VP already lost during play from missing Food and Fuel (enter as negative number).

tiebreakers.description: The Starting Player of a hypothetical 10th Half Year wins the tie.

endCondition.description: Game ends after 9 Half Years, after the November Inventorying; Peat Boat may first convert leftover Peat.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Category subtotals are entered as final VP per scoring-pad line. Animals: e.g. 6 Sheep, 5 Horses, 4 Cattle = 13 VP. Tea & Trade expansion, Advent Calendar and solo variant not modelled. Cross-check: the large scoring card exists on BGG (Fields of Arle - Large Scoring Card) but could not be downloaded. Verified via a RulesPal mirror of the rulebook, not the PDF.
